violations.description: Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment was not cleaned properly. -The floor of the pizza prep table is wet and dirty. It should be cleaned out on a regular basis.
Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. -Battery operated hand soap dispenser was out of hand cleaning liquid.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Attachments to walls and ceilings (e.g. light fixtures, vent covers, decorations etc..) were not cleanable and/or maintained in good repair. -The air duct cover behind the pizza prep table is dirty and needs cleaned.--Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. -The walk-in cooler floor has exposed wood. The Walk-in freezer has exposed wood shelves. These should be sealed.

Lighting. — --Lighting did not have protective shielding in areas where there is exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, or unwrapped single-service items. -The food dry storage area has two glass tube lights without proper shielding.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -The top of the ice-making pan (where the ice is built-up) for the ice machine is in need of cleaning.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned adequately. -The kitchen staff is using a black rolling cart in the kitchen and the bottom shelf has a build up and in need of cleaning.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. -Large pizza boxes are sitting face-up on top of a holding unit.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. -Shelves in the freezer and back storage room are made of unsealed wood and 2x4. Advised Heather to seal shelves.

General equipment and utensils - Materials and design. — --Material of nonfood contact surface was not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent and cleanable. Shelving used to store to-go items is wood that is not sealed. Shelving that is used to store food and items used in food service should be sealed.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Fan blade covers in the walk-in cooler and freezers were found dirty. These should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Design and construction of floors, walls, and ceilings. — --Exposed studs, joists or rafters were not covered with smooth, nonabsorbent and easily cleanable material. Hole found in the wall near the time clock exposing studs and piping. Walls should be properly maintained.--Floors, walls, and/or ceiling were not constructed or designed to be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable. Ceiling in the storage area is wood that has not been sealed. Ceilings should be smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable.
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Design, installation, clean, and maintained (1 pt deducted)
Clean/dry location, protected, covered, original containers, labeled (2 pts deducted)
